caption:
A lot more people have a collection account than you'd think. 📞

The New York Fed says 4.9% of consumers had a third-party collection account on their credit report in Q3 2026. That share was steady from the previous quarter.

If you see one you don't recognize, you can dispute it.

Have you ever had a surprise collection on your report?
first_comment: Ever found something on your report you didn't recognize? 👇

card.headline: 4.9% of consumers have a collection account.
